CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mail_cases (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  external_message_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  conversation_id TEXT,
  direction TEXT NOT NULL,
  case_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL,
  customer_email TEXT,
  customer_company TEXT,
  owner_email TEXT,
  waiting_for_email TEXT,
  waiting_for_company TEXT,
  subject TEXT,
  question_text TEXT,
  question_excerpt TEXT,
  order_number TEXT,
  sent_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  received_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  asked_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  answered_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  source_system TEXT DEFAULT 'office365_graph',
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  UNIQUE (external_message_id)
);

INSERT INTO mail_cases (
  external_message_id, conversation_id, direction, case_type, status,
  customer_email, customer_company, owner_email, waiting_for_email, waiting_for_company,
  subject, question_text, question_excerpt, order_number,
  sent_at, received_at, asked_at, answered_at, source_system, updated_at
) VALUES (
  {{ $json.external_message_id ? "'" + $json.external_message_id.replaceAll("'", "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.conversation_id ? "'" + $json.conversation_id.replaceAll("'", "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.direction ? "'" + $json.direction + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.case_type ? "'" + $json.case_type + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.status ? "'" + $json.status + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.customer_email ? "'" + $json.customer_email.replaceAll("'", "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.customer_company ? "'" + $json.customer_company.replaceAll("'", "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.owner_email ? "'" + $json.owner_email.replaceAll("'", "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.waiting_for_email ? "'" + $json.waiting_for_email.replaceAll("'", "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.waiting_for_company ? "'" + $json.waiting_for_company.replaceAll("'", "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.subject ? "'" + $json.subject.replaceAll("'", "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.question_text ? "'" + $json.question_text.replaceAll("'", "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.question_excerpt ? "'" + $json.question_excerpt.replaceAll("'", "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.order_number ? "'" + $json.order_number + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.sent_at ? "'" + $json.sent_at + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.received_at ? "'" + $json.received_at + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.asked_at ? "'" + $json.asked_at + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.answered_at ? "'" + $json.answered_at + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  'office365_graph',
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (external_message_id) DO UPDATE SET
  conversation_id = EXCLUDED.conversation_id,
  direction = EXCLUDED.direction,
  case_type = EXCLUDED.case_type,
  status = EXCLUDED.status,
  customer_email = EXCLUDED.customer_email,
  customer_company = EXCLUDED.customer_company,
  owner_email = EXCLUDED.owner_email,
  waiting_for_email = EXCLUDED.waiting_for_email,
  waiting_for_company = EXCLUDED.waiting_for_company,
  subject = EXCLUDED.subject,
  question_text = EXCLUDED.question_text,
  question_excerpt = EXCLUDED.question_excerpt,
  order_number = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.order_number, mail_cases.order_number),
  sent_at = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.sent_at, mail_cases.sent_at),
  received_at = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.received_at, mail_cases.received_at),
  asked_at = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.asked_at, mail_cases.asked_at),
  answered_at = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.answered_at, mail_cases.answered_at),
  updated_at = NOW();

UPDATE mail_cases outq
SET status='answered_customer', answered_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW()
FROM mail_cases inb
WHERE outq.conversation_id IS NOT NULL
  AND outq.conversation_id = inb.conversation_id
  AND outq.direction='outgoing'
  AND outq.status='waiting_customer'
  AND inb.direction='incoming';

SELECT customer_email, customer_company, waiting_for_email, waiting_for_company, subject, case_type, status,
COALESCE(asked_at, sent_at, received_at) AS event_time, order_number
FROM mail_cases
WHERE status IN ('waiting_customer','waiting_me')
ORDER BY event_time DESC
LIMIT 100;
